certifiable_standards_mapping.description: This metric is used to assess whether a QPU has error correction enabled and correctly configured.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU has a one-qubit gate error rate below a specified threshold.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU has a two-qubit gate error rate below a specified threshold.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU has a State Preparation And Measurement (SPAM) error rate below a specified threshold.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU has a readout (measurement) error rate below a specified threshold.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU has a crosstalk error rate below a specified threshold.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU maintains a T1 (energy relaxation) coherence time at or above a specified threshold.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU maintains a T2 (dephasing) coherence time at or above a specified threshold.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU executes gates within a specified maximum time so operations complete within the coherence window.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU supports a universal gate set (e.g., Clifford + T).
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU exposes at least a specified number of physical qubits.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU provides an average qubit connectivity at or above a specified threshold.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU supports a circuit depth at or above a specified threshold before decoherence dominates.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU achieves a Quantum Volume at or above a specified threshold.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU achieves Circuit Layer Operations Per Second (CLOPS) at or above a specified threshold.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU achieves a randomized-benchmarking fidelity at or above a specified threshold.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU achieves a Bell-state (entanglement) fidelity at or above a specified threshold.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU implements a quantum error-correcting code with a code distance at or above a specified threshold.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU has a logical (post error-correction) error rate below a specified threshold.
This metric is used to assess whether a QPU has continuous decoherence (T1/T2) monitoring enabled.
